messages:
iris-partnerops: FYI - EchoWare wants marketplace onboarding. Their agent emits per-minute fractional-second usage, but seller portal expects hourly entitlements. Need plan for rollup + reconciliation. cc @max-eng @toni-billing
max-eng: Can we get a sample event?
iris-partnerops: sample: {"device_id":"ew-21","sku":"echo-lite","ts":"2026-06-10T10:12:05.123Z","usage_seconds":30.2,"batch_id":"b-20260610-1012"}
toni-billing: Billing rule: convert to seconds (round to nearest), sum per UTC hour, then minutes = floor(total_seconds / 60). Idempotency by (partner_id,batch_id).
max-eng: Implementation: ingest adapter normalizes to integer seconds, dedupe on (device_id,second,sku), store raw for 90d, roll up to hour_start, emit hour event with hour_start, minutes, raw_seconds_count, ingest_id. Late arrival policy?
iris-partnerops: Partner asks 72h backfill; marketplace defaults to 48h. We accept 48h auto, 48-72h flag for manual review.
sam-ps: Product needs seller portal to show adjustment badge and optional raw-events debug view. Also daily diff webhook opt-in for partners.
ingest-bot: webhook: batch b-20260610-1012 accepted, signature OK, written to s3://partners/echoware/b-20260610-1012 at 2026-06-10T10:15:02Z
li-qa: QA tests: duplicate batch replay, fractional rounding, cross-hour boundary (10:59:59.8 -> 11:00:00.1), late arrival 49h. I'll create vectors.
toni-billing: Reconciliation: nightly job outputs run_id,hour_start,sku,partner_minutes,our_minutes,delta_minutes,reason_code. Tolerance <=1 minute or <=0.5% -> no action; else open ticket and emit partner webhook.
iris-partnerops: Actions: @max-eng spike adapter, @li-qa test vectors, @toni-billing reconciliation playbook, I'll schedule sandbox. Thanks :thumbsup:
